name: Prospective Project Universe Membership Evidence
principles: project-universe membership is separate from exchange listing, tradability and project investability
a project membership observation becomes knowable only at the actual universe snapshot observation time
active=1 is positive project-membership evidence for a stable supported security identity
active=0 is retained as an explicit inactive-row observation but is not automatically promoted to OUT_OF_SCOPE
absence from a snapshot is UNKNOWN and never an automatic negative membership claim
later snapshot absence does not silently carry forward or terminate an earlier positive claim
stable security identity requires a valid ISIN; crypto remains outside automatic stable-identity promotion
multiple rows sharing one ISIN are aggregated at security-identity level and surfaced as quality flags
listing status, venue, market tradability and project investability remain UNKNOWN in this layer
historical retrojection and productive scanner integration are forbidden
